text:
```yaml
name: Checks

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Type check
        run: pnpm tsc --noEmit

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Test
        run: pnpm test
```
